nature Electrical
  potential Voltage v "V" abstol 1e-6
  flow Current i "A" abstol 1e-12
body Isource
  param dc: f64 = 0.0
  param ac: f64 = 0.0
  node p: Electrical port
  node n: Electrical port
  branch b0 (p, n) flow
  stim S0 "ac"
  analog
    b0.flow +> direct ((dc * source_scale()) + ac_stim S0 (ac))
body IsrcR
  node a: Electrical signal
  child i1: Isource  nodes (gnd, a)  params (dc = 0.001)
  child r1: Resistor  nodes (a, gnd)  params (r = 1000.0)
body Resistor
  param r: f64 where (r > 0.0)
  node p: Electrical port
  node n: Electrical port
  branch b0 (p, n) flow
  analog
    b0.flow +> direct (probe(p, n) / r)
instance IsrcR: IsrcR  nodes (IsrcR.a)  params ()  top
instance IsrcR.i1: Isource  nodes (gnd, IsrcR.a)  params (dc = 0.001, ac = 0.0)
instance IsrcR.r1: Resistor  nodes (IsrcR.a, gnd)  params (r = 1000.0)
node IsrcR.a: Electrical  declared by IsrcR
